ITEM 1 | Six to seven small bite-sized pieces, roughly 2–3 cm each, dark reddish-brown with glossy, slightly sticky sheen and caramelized edges, smooth-skinned and firm, clustered on the left side of the plate | 90
ITEM 2 | Mixed salad greens, dark green and burgundy-red leaves with some torn pieces and a few bright red bits, moist and slightly glossy, piled in the upper right of the plate, covering roughly 1/5 of the plate | 60
ITEM 3 | Shredded pale golden-yellow starchy mass with thin browned crispy edges and some darker toasted bits, loosely piled in the lower right, covering roughly 1/6 of the plate, about 2 cm thick, crumbly and dry-looking | 110
